Card Q&A.a: You can give that effect to such Digimon, but if the Digimon isn't affected by effects upon the trigger timing, the gained effect won't trigger.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to give "[Start of Your Main Phase] This Digimon attacks" to a Digimon that isn't affected by effects?

Effect: While you have a Digimon with [Knightmon] in its text, you may ignore this card's color requirements.
[Main] Until the end of your opponent's turn, give 1 of their Digimon "[Start of Your Main Phase] This Digimon attacks." Then, place this card in the battle area.
・1 of your Digimon gains ＜Piercing＞ and ＜Security A. +1＞ until the end of your turn.
Security Effect: [Security] You may play 1 level 5 or lower Digimon card with [Knightmon] in its text from your trash without paying the cost. Then, place this card in the battle area.
